content.text: Neon does not bill overages on the Free plan.

Writes that would grow storage past the cap fail until you free space or upgrade.

Some sources disagree on storage. Several third-party pages and one Neon FAQ page say 0.5 GB per project. Neon's plans page and its Free-plan limits FAQ say 1 GB, and a page from 10 days ago also says 1 GB. I'd go with 1 GB, but check Neon's pricing page before you rely on it.
